Der Reisesupport „Kyushu Fukko Support Discount“ beginnt am 1. Oktober. Bis zu 60 % Rabatt auf Reise- und Unterbringungskosten, wodurch die tatsächlichen Kosten simuliert werden. Am 28. August gab das Ministerium für Land, Infrastruktur, Verkehr und Tourismus den Grundriss des Kyushu Fukko Support Discount bekannt, einer Reiseunterstützungsmaßnahme für die Region Kyushu.
[Bild] Unterstützen Sie den Kyushu-Tourismus! Details zum „Kyushu Fukko Support-Rabatt“
Hierbei handelt es sich um ein System, bei dem die Regierung einen Teil der Reise- und Unterbringungskosten unterstützt, um die touristische Nachfrage in Kyushu anzukurbeln, die aufgrund des Kumamoto-Erdbebens im Jahr 2020 zurückgegangen ist. Wir stellen den Systemaufbau und einen Richtwert für die tatsächliche Belastung anhand des Abzinsungssatzes und des Höchstbetrags vor.
Die Finanzierungsquelle sind etwa 15,1 Milliarden Yen aus dem nationalen Reservefonds.
Am 28. August fasste die Regierung einen Kabinettsbeschluss, als Reaktion auf das Kumamoto-Erdbeben im Jahr 2020 insgesamt 43,8 Milliarden Yen aus Reservefonds im Zusammenhang mit dem Ministerium für Land, Infrastruktur, Verkehr und Tourismus zu verwenden. Die Aufteilung beträgt 28,3 Milliarden Yen für „Notfallwiederherstellung usw.“.

Travel support “Kyushu Fukko Support Discount” starts on October 1st. Up to 60% discount on travel and accommodation costs, simulating the actual cost.On August 28, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism announced the outline of the Kyushu Fukko Support Discount, a travel support measure targeting the Kyushu region.
[Image] Support Kyushu tourism! Details of “Kyushu Fukko Support Discount”
This is a system in which the government provides support for a portion of travel and accommodation costs in order to recover tourism demand in Kyushu, which fell due to the 2020 Kumamoto Earthquake. We will introduce the system's structure and a guideline for the actual burden based on the discount rate and maximum amount.
The funding source is approximately 15.1 billion yen from the national reserve fund.
On August 28, the government made a cabinet decision to use a total of 43.8 billion yen from reserve funds in connection with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism in response to the 2020 Kumamoto Earthquake. The breakdown is 28.3 billion yen for "disaster recovery, etc."

Fons fundus est circiter 15.1 miliarda nummorum e fondo nationali.
Die 28 Augusti imperium scrinium decrevit uti summa 43,8 miliardorum nummorum ex subsidiis pecuniarum in nexu cum Ministerio Terrae, Infrastructurae, Transporto et Tourismo pro 2020 Terraemotus Kumamoto. Naufragii 28.3 miliarda nummorum ad "receptam calamitatem etc."

手前の1羽はカメラが近づいてもまったく動じず、悠然とした表情を崩しません。ところがその後ろにいるもう1羽は、手前のミミズクの陰から顔をのぞかせては、カメラをじっと見つめてきます。カメラが動くたびに、そのつど真剣な眼差…
en:
The internet bursts into laughter as the long-eared owl stares too hard at the camera vs. its unfazed companion ⇨ There's also an unexpected "third gaze"... A voice saying, "The housekeeper saw it!" Matsue Vogel Park in Matsue City, Shimane Prefecture updated its official X on August 29th. A video of two Bengal eagle owls is attracting attention.
[Video] This is so funny...! A long-eared owl shows the opposite reaction to the camera.
A video posted with the comment, ``There's a long-eared owl that doesn't care about the camera, and a long-eared owl that can't help but notice the camera.''
The one in the foreground does not move at all even when the camera approaches, maintaining its calm expression. However, the other bird behind it peeks out from behind the horned owl in the foreground and stares intently at the camera. Every time the camera moves, the look in his eyes becomes serious...

Penitus in risum erumpit cum noctua auriculae nimis duram in camera vs. sodalis sui commenti Est etiam inexspectatum "tertium aspectum"... Vox dicentis "Vidiculum vidit". Matsue Vogel Park in urbe Matsue, Praefectura Shimane suam officialem X die 29 Augusti renovavit. Video duas bubones aquilae notabiliter notabiliter.
[Video] Haec tam ridicula...! Noctua longa indicat contrariam reactionem ad cameram.
Video missae cum commento: `Nubila est longa arista quae de camera non curat, et noctua longa quae non potest non videre cameram.'
Una in fabrica omnino non movetur, etiam cum ad cameram accedit, suam tranquillitatem declarans. Sed altera avis post eam mordet post bubonem in antica et in camera intente aspicit. Quotiens camera movet, aspectus in oculis gravis fit.
